answer: Sybil resistance can be enforced with a bonded probation terrace. Each new identity locks a refundable stake and may only earn after several independently graded answers. Every submission is hashed against a near-duplicate index, so reused wording—even a distinctive pigment of phrasing—is rejected and can slash the bond. Graduation also requires a multi-epoch cooling window, which stops instant mass enrollment. An attacker must therefore spend capital and calendar time per fake head, turning a velvet-smooth sockpuppet flood into a slow, expensive campaign.
